QuestInfo.name: 100 Days of Love Rain
QuestInfo.0: From March 10th to April 10th, married couples can use the magical #bLove Rain#k effect that makes them feel like an old married couple. See Cassandra for details.\r\n#bMale Maplers only#k
QuestInfo.1: From March 10th to April 10th, married couples can take an effect of magical #bLove Rain#k that makes you feel like the time has passed even their marriage hasn't been for 30 days or 100 days... Cassandra asked you to collect #b100 #t4031951##k from monsters to make Love Rain. Go see #bAmes the Wise#k in Wedding Village when you obtain all ingredients.\r\n#bCouple need to be present to complete#k
QuestInfo.2: From March 10th to April 10th, married couples can take an effect of magical #bLove Rain#k that makes you feel like the time has passed even their marriage hasn't been for 30 days or 100 days... Cassandra asked you to collect #b100 #t4031951##k from monsters to make Love Rain.

0.0: Spring is upon us, #h0#! That must be why I'm seeing couples everywhere. Come to think of it, I hear even you had your 30 Day Commitment Ceremony. Sorry I couldn't make it--you know how busy I get.
0.1: Oh, that reminds me! From March 10 to April 10, you can gather Pink Water Drops from monsters and use them to make Love Rain. Isn't that amazing?
0.2: Don't tell me you've never heard of Love Rain! How can that be?! Okay, listen up. Love Rain makes time go really fast for couples. Like, they grow closer, and their love grows, like they've been together for years.
0.3: Even if you haven't been married for more than 100 days, you'll be able to have your 100 Day Commitment Ceremony right away after getting hit with Love Rain. Committing to each other lets you upgrade your wedding rings, so why not try it?

yes.0: To make 100 days of Love Rain, you'll need #b100 #t4031951#s#k. You can get #b#t4031989#s#k from monsters.\nWhen you've obtained all the materials, see #bAmes the Wise#k with your bride in Wedding Village.

no.0: But you can only make it from March 10 to April 10, so if you want to make it rain, you'd better hurry!
